verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the MI325X ships with a software ecosystem (ROCm, the HIP runtime, libraries, AMD SMI), so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning, release compatibility guarantees or a documented deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
